headline_marked: Probe launched into [[police negligence during Mirpur health centre attack]]
headline: Probe launched into police negligence during Mirpur health centre attack
summary: A three-member committee will investigate if police failed to act as a mob looted and demolished the Radda MCH-FP Centre.
details: A three-member committee has been formed to investigate whether police negligence contributed to the vandalism and looting at the Radda MCH-FP Centre in Mirpur, Dhaka.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed stated that the extent of the damage suggests the attack took considerable time and could not have been carried out in just 30 to 60 minutes.
Equipment, including routers and other machinery, were looted from the facility, and tin-roofed structures on both sides of the building were demolished.
Four people have already been arrested and sent to jail, while a case has been filed naming one person and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.
The DMP commissioner noted that the incident occurred within 1.5km of the Darus Salam Police Station, raising questions about the response time of the officers.
Investigations are also underway regarding allegations linking reserved-seat MP Jannatul Ferdous Misty to the attack and looting.
Commissioner Ahmed stressed that no political or social identity would protect offenders, and anyone involved in illegal activities will be brought to justice.
caption:
A health centre in Mirpur was demolished and looted by a mob. Now, a probe is investigating if the police were just watching.

A three-member committee has been formed to investigate whether police negligence contributed to the vandalism and looting at the Radda MCH-FP Centre in Mirpur, Dhaka.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed stated that the extent of the damage suggests the attack took considerable time and could not have been carried out in just 30 to 60 minutes.

Equipment, including routers and other machinery, were looted from the facility, and tin-roofed structures on both sides of the building were demolished.

Four people have already been arrested and sent to jail, while a case has been filed naming one person and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.

The DMP commissioner noted that the incident occurred within 1.5km of the Darus Salam Police Station, raising questions about the response time of the officers.

Investigations are also underway regarding allegations linking reserved-seat MP Jannatul Ferdous Misty to the attack and looting.

Commissioner Ahmed stressed that no political or social identity would protect offenders, and anyone involved in illegal activities will be brought to justice.

headline_marked: Virat Kohli reveals [[2027 World Cup will be his last]] for India
headline: Virat Kohli reveals 2027 World Cup will be his last for India
summary: The legendary batter says he is ready to give his all to lift the trophy in his final 50-over World Cup appearance.
details: Virat Kohli has announced that the 2027 ODI World Cup will be his final appearance for India. The 37-year-old batter expressed his motivation to leave everything on the field to help India win the trophy.

Kohli, who has scored 14,941 runs in ODIs and holds the record for the most centuries (54), has already retired from T20 internationals and Test cricket. He now represents India exclusively in the 50-over format.
The 2027 tournament will be jointly hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia. This will mark Kohli's fifth ODI World Cup, having previously won the title in 2011.
Kohli described the 50-over World Cup as one of cricket's toughest challenges due to the high intensity required over 10 games, especially when playing in foreign conditions.
Former captain Rohit Sharma, who also only plays ODIs for India, stated he remains fully motivated for another World Cup campaign and is looking forward to the tournament.
Both Kohli and Rohit have been named in India's squad for the upcoming three-match ODI series against the West Indies, starting in Thiruvananthapuram.
